mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, it is a clear 76 degrees at Fireman's Park, under a Waning Gibbous moon. Tonight, the temperature will dip to 60 degrees, and we are expecting a dry night without any rain.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that they can now access official traffic crash reports online through crashdocs.org. For other sensitive records, please note that requests involve a redaction process and may take up to 10 business days to fulfill.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, the Remote Area Medical Clinic is open at Verona Area High School. Also, check out live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy call from the weekly report, on July 26, officers arrested an 83-year-old woman for hit-and-run and an improper left turn following a crash near West Verona Avenue.
Stop by Culver's for today's flavor, Oreo Cookie Cheesecake, which is available until they close at 10 PM. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today between 11 AM and 2 PM.
